title: Adapt English and Thai wording dynamically to customer context, channel, and buyer stage
context_summary: First-time web visitors, LINE 1:1 shoppers, and B2B group operators expect different copy density and tone.
observation: Uniform technical wording reduces comprehension when switching between LINE Flex Cards, /neurohands steps, and Notion docs.
verified_action: Tailor concise, context-matched bilingual wording per surface while keeping Neurohands hardware and governance terms consistent.
